opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or other UK higher education institutions, and UK-based independent research institutes (trial). Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects up to £500,000 over up to five years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (research degree awarding powers) coordinating the visit; specialist arts institutions also permitted.
opportunities.summary: Invite an eminent overseas professor for a 3‑12 month visit to enhance skills and knowledge in an under‑represented research area.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 (year 1) and £28,000 (years 2‑3) salary contribution plus up to £6,000 research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers without a permanent full‑time UK academic post, doctorate held, within four years of thesis submission, UK degree or UK academic position, not holding a permanent post.
opportunities.summary: Support early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work for three years.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK university or independent research institute staff, resident in the UK ≥26 weeks, established research record.
opportunities.summary: Support retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs covered; up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Employed at an eligible UK university, distinguished researcher in humanities or social sciences, not previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Support well‑established researchers to complete a piece of original research in humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers; collaborative centres allowed; one application per university as principal applicant.
opportunities.summary: Fund large‑scale research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship, up to £10 million over up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent), ≥2 years post‑PhD experience, not previously led a research team or held a comparable award.
opportunities.summary: Support talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team for a 4‑5 year project.
